lines.x: I hope you're not a pain to deal with like Monica, Doctor.
Monica sure has a weird taste. Did you know she thought about using things like Seer or Baker as her code name? Incandescence sounds about normal now, yeah?
Skadi and Specter are Ægirs, like me. Whenever I see them, I feel like… You know, my heart starts racing. Geez… If this is what I think it is, maybe I should dress up…

To be honest, I wasn't really interested in coming to Rhodes Island at first. After all, Monica was the one you hired, and I'm just her bodyguard. But then she didn't need one anymore and finding a new job gets my tentacles all tied in a knot, so I decided to tag along and take my chances here.

Monica and I lived together back in Iberia. Taking care of someone as unorganized and impulsive as her was a pesky chore… But she was the best option I had. I don't get along with my family and she was the one who took me in.

The Inquisition used to give me loads of trouble for my crossbow. They'd disassemble it, inspect the structure, and then give me a tongue-lashing for modifying it to look like a rifle. Yep, I know my weapon gives people the wrong idea, but I don't care. The Inquisition eventually gave up and just asked that I don't go scaring people with it. Heheh.

Doctor, Rhodes Island doesn't have anything against operators making friends, right? Nah, I was just thinking about hanging out with those Laterano folks. I have been into their guns since I was little, so I tried to style one myself. And that's how this beauty came to be.

You know, my Mom once told me that something happened to me when I was little, but I can't remember it for the life of me. Mom doesn't seem too eager to tell me, either. Meh. I'm doing fine now, so I guess it mustn't have been a big deal.

I gotta hand it to you, Doctor. Taking care of Monica alone takes everything out of me, but you have to take care of so many operators… Anyway, let me know if you ever need help. You know, you're not the only caretaker around here.
Your work-rest balance is all out of whack, just like Monica. Alright… where's the blanket…

I used to be Monica's... Err, I guess it's Incandescence now... Anyway, I used to be her bodyguard. She finally found herself a proper job now, so I'm free to do other stuff. That's all. Hope we get along well.
So this is how the pros do things...

Before I came, I thought to myself, a security guard at a pharmaceutical company would be pretty chill. And if I didn't make the cut, janitorial work would also be fine. Not gonna lie, I'm starting to regret my decision a bit.
Honestly, I never thought I'd achieve something like this... You know, getting stronger wasn't on my list before, but this feeling isn't half bad. Thanks, Doctor.
Time for the mission? Got it.
I'm leading? Mm... I'll try my best.
Hope we don't find trouble.
Shoot, here we go again.
Ready to move.
I'd like to listen to some music.
Enemy unaware, for now.
The visibility's pretty good here.
Breathe… Focus…
Hello. And goodbye.
That person's pretty fashionable…
So many enemies. How annoying.
Doctor, want some candy? You can relax now. I'm spent, too.
I'll double-check to see if we missed anything.
That's good enough, right? Saves us both the trouble.
Let's go, Doctor. I've secured the retreat route.
Guess I'll take a look around first.
Hey...
Doctor, is there anything I can help with?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. This is my first time celebrating with so many people, and it's not bad at all. Oh, speaking of which, I was supposed to write a letter to Mom before I left, but I totally forgot. Gotta write one now.
Doctor, want some candy?

Happy birthday! Here's your present. I bought Monica one, and it worked really well, so I got you one, too. The bane of you people with messed-up work and rest schedules: an ultra-mega alarm clock. Fail to follow a schedule and you'll get an alarm loud enough to cause a tsunami.

I never had many plans for the future to begin with, and I never thought I'd come this far. Looking back, I made the right decision to come here with Monica... How do I see the future now? Hm... Man, what a question. I got nothing.
